thread:
Mara: Proposal — add a 'Fallback billing preview' section in Console so customers can see when routing fallbacks cause invoice-preview deltas. We saw ~3% delta for a couple tenants last week. Thoughts? :thinking:
Joel: Which tenants/examples? is this the EU fallback canary we're still debugging?
Mara: example org_8a3f — quick query I ran: `SELECT count(*) FROM metering.events WHERE fallback=true AND tenant='org_8a3f' AND ts > now() - interval '7 days'` returned ~14k events and a clear spike after the routing promo burst.
Alex: Do we show raw event counts or the post-dedupe expected invoice? UX impacts trust: if console shows 'corrected' numbers but we later invoice differently customers will be confused.
Sanjay: We currently don't emit `fallback_reason` or `route_variant` in telemetry. Adding those helps correlation but will increase cardinality. We need a sampling/rollout plan.
Tara: From billing side — we need the console to label previews like `Preview (raw events)` vs `Preview (post-reconcile estimate)`. Also link to reconciliation docs explaining dedupe windows.
Beth: UX suggestion: small pill in invoice preview: `Fallbacks: 1.2k tokens` — expandable to a sample list of traces (time, proxy, route_variant) and a link to the raw events. Optionally an admin toggle: `Exclude fallbacks from preview`.
Joel: Operationally, incremental approach: 1) add `fallback=true` + `route_variant` tags on live events, 2) build lightweight daily aggregates that compute fallback token ratio per-tenant, 3) surface a badge in Console if ratio > 0.5%. That avoids backfilling at first.
Sanjay: Rollout plan idea: live tagging for all traffic, but backfill only for top N tenants (by token volume) sampled at 10% for the retro scan. Full backfill is expensive and will create extra load.
Mara: Also consider short-term ledger-side mitigation: dedupe near-term duplicates by adding a de-duplication key `(tenant, request_fingerprint, hour)` with a soft constraint. That would reduce duplicate invoice events while we fix upstream routing.
Tara: Soft dedupe is acceptable only if it's opt-in/canary. It changes semantics for retries. Accounting wants a canary window where dedupe marks events as `potential_duplicate` but doesn't drop them until verified.
Joel: Action items I propose: (A) Sanjay — add telemetry tags + open infra ticket for sampled backfill; (B) Alex — implement daily aggregate + badge API; (C) Beth — design expandable fallback panel + admin toggle; (D) Tara & Accounting — define canary dedupe policy. Ship as a 5% Console canary.
Beth: I'll post a mockup tomorrow morning and include the copy for the `post-reconcile estimate` tooltip. :thumbsup:
Sanjay: I'll open metering#1234 with the tagging plan and the sampling/backfill cost estimate. One note: cap `route_variant` cardinality (e.g., top 50) to avoid explosion for self-serve tenants.
Mara: Great. @deploy-bot when metering#1234 is green can we kick off a small canary?
deploy-bot: CI pipeline triggered for metering#1234 (canary build). Logs: https://ci.internal/reports/987 — will post deploy status in #eng-releases.
Joel: Thanks everyone — let's sync tomorrow for roll-out timing.
Beth: will add a short FAQ blurb about why preview may differ from final invoice (dedupe window, reconciliation lag).
_meta_note: This thread proposes Console UX and telemetry changes to surface routing fallback impact on invoice previews; includes operational rollout and canary plans. All messages are in Slack style and chronological.
